reviewed_changes.signal: The parent QA body still contains the older manual Gatekeeper workaround text (`xattr -cr`, ad-hoc `codesign --sign -`) even though later evidence says the CDN staging DMG is Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled, and accepted by spctl.
reviewed_changes.decision: Do not treat the parent page body install workaround as current release truth. Use the signed/notarized DMG comments and repository evidence until the body is cleaned up.

reviewed_changes.signal: The CW structured page keeps CW-AIA-001..011 normalized, with CW-AIA-003/006/009 marked confirmed and the remaining eight items still open.
reviewed_changes.decision: The backfilled CW inventory is still aligned with operational-readiness. Backend/control-plane has no new blocker from this subpage.

reviewed_changes.signal: CW-AIA-001/002 require product onboarding policy, while CW-AIA-004/005/007/008/010/011 require client/design screenshot comparison. None of these are closable by backend API evidence alone.
reviewed_changes.decision: Keep `staging_client_p0_visual_retest` partial until product decisions and screenshot evidence close the open CW-AIA items.

reviewed_changes.signal: After the earlier Notion backfill, additional page-level comments record staging public burst evidence, deploy-overlap burst evidence, and daemon reconnect/runtimeactor evidence. These comments advance backend/infra readiness without changing the remaining client/design partial boundary.
reviewed_changes.decision: Treat these as backend/infra evidence extensions. They do not close visual/client QA items.

reviewed_changes.signal: The parent page still shows `서버 배포: NO`, while page comments and repository PRs record multiple control-plane/backend evidence and deploy-related completions.
reviewed_changes.decision: Continue treating the page-level deploy property as client-release scope, not backend/control-plane deployment truth.
